styles.name: Habitual
styles.plays: the subclass's main action 9 times in 13, anything else otherwise

styles.name: By the book
styles.plays: the subclass's usual mix, exactly as the prior assumes

styles.name: Random
styles.plays: uniformly at random, ignoring everything (the floor)

styles.name: Alternator
styles.plays: Strike, Guard, Strike, Guard, ...

styles.name: Switcher
styles.plays: Shoot for four turns, then Strike for the rest of the fight

styles.name: Contrarian
styles.plays: by the book, but never its subclass's main action when named

styles.name: Second-guesser
styles.plays: by the book, but when named avoids whatever it has done most so far

styles.name: Adaptive
styles.plays: by the book, but shies away from any action a prophecy caught it doing, and slowly forgets

styles.name: Tell-reader
styles.plays: by the book, but steers away from the actions the boss has bet on about it, named or not
